requirements.description: Cite at least 3 Bible stories that mention the use of ropes.
Which knot should be used to start a lashing?

Tie the following lashings:
  a. Square
  b. Diagonal
  c. Parallel or round
  d. Japanese square lashing
  e. Figure-eight lashing
  f. Single continuous lashing
  g. Double continuous lashing
  h. Continuous diagonal lashing
  i. Double continuous diagonal lashing
Describe why the cords of some furniture loosen after a few days.
